description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] if entry damage was Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind, grants [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode], and [Zenith Mode: Arciela] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Arciela
description.text: Increases [Ice/Lightning/Wind/Water Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Ice, Lightning, Wind or Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Arciela after using two Ice, Lightning, Wind or Water abilities (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Harmonic Displacement+
description.text: Five single attacks (3.80/3.95 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Arciela
description.text: Grants [Ice/Lightning/Water/Wind Ability +10% Boost 3]/[Prismatic Ability +30% Boost 3] if 0-3/4+ FFXI allies are alive

description.name: Attach Ice 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Attach Water 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
